q: The entropy rate of a hidden Markov process (output of an HMM) can be computed via the:
opts: Belief states / Blackwell measure (stationary distribution over conditional distributions given past observations)
The Perron eigenvalue of the hidden transition matrix
exp: The entropy rate of a sofic process is h = H(Y₀|Y₋₁,Y₋₂,...) which requires knowing the conditional distribution given all past outputs — captured by the 'belief state' or Blackwell measure. Computing this exactly is generally intractable (no closed form).
